summary: Issue #726: isolate which clap-validator test triggers the param-fuzz panic on test_fault (exit 0xc0000409 / exit 101 no JSON)

Hypothesis: param-fuzz-sample-accurate alone kills the validator (Issue title attribution). Test: run clap-validator validate --json --plugin-id org.ruviform-test.clap-test-fault --include '^param-fuzz-sample-accurate$' target/debug/ruviform_plugin_test_clap.dll

REJECTED: param-fuzz-sample-accurate emits clean JSON {crashed: exit code 0xc0000409}, validator exit 1 (crashed test present, JSON still emitted). The abort-mode child death is handled correctly via SandboxError::Crashed. Issue title attribution is wrong.

Hypothesis: the killer is whichever param-mutating test arms Fault plain value 2.0 (exit mode, exit code 0). Stepped fuzzer rng.rs random_value().round() over [0,4] emits {0,1,2,3,4}; exit(0) makes the sandboxed child exit SUCCESS without writing result JSON -> sandbox.rs:98 expect() deserialize panic -> cli.rs:55 scoped thread panic -> exit 101 no JSON.

CONFIRMED: --include param-fuzz-basic and --include param-fuzz-modulation each reproduce exit 101 + sandbox.rs:98 deserialize EOF panic + cli.rs:55 scoped thread panic in ~15ms with empty stdout. -j1 moves panic to main thread directly. test_gain param-fuzz-basic passes (control). param-fuzz-bounds reports failed (CLAP_PROCESS_ERROR = error mode 4.0), param-set reports failed (upstream issue 42 symptom), preset-discovery times out 45s (issue 41 fix not in 0.4.1 binary).

DECISION: root cause is upstream clap-validator bug (success-exit-without-output not treated as crash; worker panic loses all results), present on master 5bc2ef3, no existing upstream issue -> report warranted (draft at evidence/rf726/upstream-report-draft.md, filing is Coordinator hand-off). Runner contract already fail-closed (normalizeClapLeg Unsupported + run.test.mjs:161 pin) -> zero-diff. Leg handling: keep canonical param-(set|fuzz) exclude + informational Unsupported; resume unfiltered run after upstream fix release is pinned.

LANE RUN FINDING: opt-in lane with pre-fix runner recorded all fixture legs as 'Failed - spawn error ETIMEDOUT' although each leg .txt contains a COMPLETE validator JSON report. Root cause: runClapLeg spawnSync pipe stdio - orphaned sandboxed grandchildren (preset-discovery deadlock, upstream issue 41, unfixed in 0.4.1) inherit and hold the pipes after validator exit, so spawnSync waits for pipe EOF until the 300s timeout and proc.error preempts the parsed JSON. Also discovered preset-discovery-crawl/load regression: skipped in rf630/rf732 evidence, now crash at 45s timeout on every fixture leg (upstream deadlock, not fixture intentional-fault surface).

DECISION (runner fix): add spawnCapture (file-backed stdio spawnSync wrapper) and apply to runClapLeg only; runVst3Leg unchanged (Steinberg validator spawns no sandbox grandchildren). Leg definitions, exclude conditions, and verdict vocabulary unchanged. preset-discovery crashes are NOT excluded - unlike param-fuzz they are not the fixture's intentional fatal surface, so legs honestly record Failed until an upstream release fixes issue 41. Contract tests +2 (grandchild stdio inheritance returns at child exit; spawn failure/timeout stays fail-closed). node --test: 23 pass.
